title: Annotatio IV §.III from Prior (2): Practical heresy — no room for charity’s judgment; worst-part reading
pass_a_gloss: (2.) To labor under practical heresy, i.e. to leave no place for Charity’s judgment, and to interpret everything said by dissenters in the worst possible part.
pass_b_english: (2.) Labor under practical heresy — leave no room for charity’s judgment, and take everything dissenters say in the worst possible sense.
source_text: (2.) Haeresi practica laborare, i. e. Charitatis judicio nullum locum relinquere, omniaque à dissentientibus dicta in pessinam quamque partem interpretari.
